name: Question 19
problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A$, where

$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}y{e}^{x+1},\, & \text{if}\,0<x<1,\,-2<y<0, \\ 3y\sqrt{x},\, & \text{if}\,1<x<4,\,-2<y<0,\end{aligned}
$$

and  $R$ is the domain of $f.$

Question 19
?

Evaluate the double integral ∬Rf(x,y)dA, where f(x,y)={yex+1,if0<x<1,−2<y<0,3yx,if1<x<4,−2<y<0, and R is the domain of f.

a
 −e2+2e−14
b
 2e2−e+14
c
 −2e2−28
d
 2e2−e
e
 −2e2+2e−28
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, notice that we have R=R1∪R2, where R1=(0,1)×(−2,0) and R2=(1,4)×(−2,0). So, we can write

∬Rf(x,y)dA==∬R1f(x,y)dA+∬R2f(x,y)dA=∬R1yex+1dA+∬R23yxdA=∬R1(ex+1)(y)dA+∬R2(x)(3y)dA=(∫01ex+1dx)(∫−20ydy)+(∫14xdx)(∫−203ydy)=[ex+1]01⋅[y22]−20+[2x33]14⋅[3y22]−20=(e2−e)⋅(0−2)+(163−23)⋅(0−6)=−2e2+2e−28.
